definition.name: json_object
definition.description: Build one JSON object whose fields are the step's named inputs.

implementations.source:
"""Build one JSON object from the step's named inputs.

Each input becomes a field of the same name, so a step can gather values
from several earlier steps, constants and the workflow input into one
object. A step with no inputs builds an empty object.
"""

import json
import sys

inputs = json.loads(sys.stdin.buffer.read().decode("utf-8"))

sys.stdout.buffer.write(json.dumps({"value": inputs}, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8"))
